tasks.title: Research and verify lesson evidence
tasks.body: Run the accepted Research Orchestration and deterministic Fact Verification stages for the lesson brief already stored in the shared job workspace. Preserve provenance and blocked-claim semantics. Write research_pack.json, evidence_graph.json, and fact_verification.json to the shared workspace. Do not write narration, visual geometry, or publication policy.

tasks.title: Build the approved pedagogy plan
tasks.body: Consume only the accepted research_pack.json, evidence_graph.json, and fact_verification.json from the shared workspace. Run the existing Pedagogy Agent task/gate and write pedagogy_plan.json. Do not rerun research merely because this card restarted; upstream research is a completed parent and remains authoritative unless a routed repair creates new work.

tasks.title: Write the verified lesson script
tasks.body: Consume the accepted pedagogy_plan.json plus approved factual artifacts. Run the existing Script Agent task/gate and write script.json. Preserve exact approved claim IDs and objective coverage. Do not introduce visual coordinates or renderer implementation.

tasks.title: Create semantic lesson visuals
tasks.body: Consume the accepted script.json and pedagogy artifacts. Run the existing Visual Director with the deterministic ConceptRegistry and write storyboard.json, concept_registry.json, and scenegraphs/. Keep output semantic-only and require Core readiness.

tasks.title: Render the accepted lesson pipeline
tasks.body: Consume Core-ready semantic artifacts from the shared workspace and execute the accepted Lesson Pipeline Core handoff through learnflow_create, learnflow_run, learnflow_render, and deterministic final assembly. Produce final.mp4 and render/artifact manifests. Do not change frozen Core implementation or invent renderer controls.

tasks.title: Review lesson quality and publication readiness
tasks.body: Consume the rendered lesson and typed artifact chain. Run authoritative scene/video QA, Agent-Aware QA ownership routing when needed, and the reviewed pre-publication readiness procedure. Do not self-authorize publication. If a repair is required, create/route only the owner-specific follow-up work permitted by Agent-Aware QA and re-review affected outputs.
